design.name: Option B - bounded mirror key columns
design.summary: Keep wide FK columns (sparePartId/warehouseId/maintenance_request_id NVARCHAR(1000)); add NVARCHAR(200) stored mirror key columns with trusted CHECKs (mirror = source exact equality, source LEN <= 200); move uniqueness and performance indexes onto bounded mirrors; locally narrow non-FK key columns (scb.id, scb.productId, sla_rules.id, sla_states.id); add canonical FKs to converge production divergence.

sql_server_batch_constraint_evidence.observation: Prisma migrate deploy does not honor GO batch separators; a migration SQL batch compiles as a single unit, so DDL referencing columns added earlier in the same batch fails with error 207 (invalid column name). The GO test migration failed with error 102 (incorrect syntax near GO).
sql_server_batch_constraint_evidence.resolution: Split corrective into phase 1 (pure nullable ADD COLUMN, no references to new columns) and phase 2 (backfill, NOT NULL, CHECKs, index/PK changes, FK adds referencing existing columns). Both phases applied cleanly.

object_matrix_divergent.shape: production-mirror: 79 baseline migrations, then dropped 2 SCB FKs, converted unique constraint to unique nonclustered index on (sparePartId, warehouseId, condition) at 4100 bytes (warning>1700), then correctives applied
object_matrix_divergent.state_after_correctives: identical to probe object matrix: all indexes safe, UQ 900B on mirrors, 3 FKs, all CHECKs trusted
object_matrix_divergent.note: IF is_unique_constraint=1 DROP CONSTRAINT ELSE DROP INDEX branch handles both production shape variants idempotently; FK adds use IF NOT EXISTS.

schema_contract_alignment.issue_found: SCB model declared productId String? and condition String without explicit db width; Prisma defaults both to nvarchar(1000), which would instruct future 'prisma migrate dev' to widen the narrowed columns back and re-bloat IX_scb_productId (~2000B) and the UQ key (over prisma's 900B index-key limit).
schema_contract_alignment.diff_after_fix_for_four_tables: only index/PK/FK naming renames to Prisma defaults (cosmetic, pre-existing repo-wide pattern); zero ALTER COLUMN, zero width changes, zero new unsafe objects
